title: TikTok's US entity says it is closing its Nashville office, which held some of its content moderation team; filing: TikTok laid off 250 employees at the office (Emmett Lindner/New York Times)
summary: Emmett Lindner / New York Times: TikTok's US entity says it is closing its Nashville office, which held some of its content moderation team; filing: TikTok laid off 250 employees at the office — The office was home to members of the app's content moderation team. — TikTok's U.S. joint venture said on Wednesday …
contentText:
Emmett Lindner / New York Times :

TikTok's US entity says it is closing its Nashville office, which held some of its content moderation team; filing: TikTok laid off 250 employees at the office   —  The office was home to members of the app's content moderation team.  —  TikTok's U.S. joint venture said on Wednesday …
